en-US.name: DropZone
en-US.summary: Checks your yard's drone drop zone with your Ring camera before a delivery drone arrives.
en-US.description: DropZone tells you if the drone drop zone in your yard is clear, can ask the drone to wait, and offers to set the pet door, yard lights or sprinklers only when you say yes. Hackathon prototype: the frame source is a simulated replay and the devices are simulated.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask drop zone is the yard clear
Alexa, ask drop zone to ask the drone to wait
